tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtor bsngos bsdus pa bzhugs so//

/rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// thugs srog las spros raṃ yaṃ khaṃ// me rlung chu yis ba liṃ ni// nyes skyon bsregs sbyangs gtor nas kyang*// rlung me'i steng du thod sgyed steng*// bde skyong yangs shing rgya chen nang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥdag dang*// māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan// hūm̐ zhes sna bug rlung gis sbud// rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas zhu zhing*// khol bas nyes skyon lbu ba'i tshul// lud cing dwangs ma mer gyis khengs// kha chod zla steng hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ// brtsegs las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi bkug /'dres shing yig gsum zla bar bcas// 'od zhu bdud rtsir thim pa yis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// nor lha phyogs skyong gzhi bdag dang*/ *// bgegs rigs lan chags 'gro drug bcas// spyan drangs sprin ltar mdun du gtibs// arghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mgron rigs gong ma nas rim bzhin// ljags 'od rdo rje'i sbu gu yis// gtor ma drangs gsol mnyes tshim gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// drug pa rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dbang lung man ngag gdams pa dang*// gsar rnying rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang mchog thob par// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// auṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam bya spyod rnal 'byor dang*| |rnal 'byor bla med kyis bsdus pa'i// bde dgyes dus gsang 'jigs byed dang*// dmar nag mā yā sgyu ma dang*// gdan bzhi la sogs rgyal ba'i lha// zhi khro rab 'byams gsar rnying gi// yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// mi mthun sdig sgrib tshogs dag nas// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dam can rgya mtsho mthu stobs can// dpal mgon phyag bzhi bya rog mtshan// phyag drug gur zhal beng ma ning*| |stag zhon la sogs mgon po'i tshogs// bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma dang*// smug nag lcam dral ha ra nag /zhing skyong seng gdong rā hu la// pe har gnod sbyin rtsi dmar sogs| |chos skyong 'khor bcas gtor ma rnams// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bar chad nad gdon dgra bgegs sgrol// rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe srings// chos dang bstan pa srung zhing spel// bdag gi bsam don 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnam mang thos sras dzaṃ bha la// gnod sbyin nor bdag pho mo rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon bcas| |bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// chos ldan longs spyod spel bar mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen dang*// phyogs skyong bcu sogs gtsang ris kyi// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs// mchod sbyin mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnam sa bar gsum phyogs bcu yi// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas rnams dang*// khyad par yul gnas 'di dag gi// bdag po 'khor bcas gtor ma 'di// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bdag 'dod chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// lan chags bu lon sha 'khon bdag /gang yin mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// gnod sems zhi nas phan sems bskyed// lan chags byang zhing bu lon 'khor// sha 'khon dag cing 'khor bar mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro drug sems can mtha' yas tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// rang rang sdug bsngal tshogs zhi nas// phan bde byang sems ldan gyur cig |slar arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

yig brgya brjod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron rigs rnams// mkha' la sprin tshogs dengs pa ltar// rang rang gnas su badzra muḥ /gang tshe spyan drangs 'byon par gsol// zhes dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam yang bya'o// gtor bsngos tshang ma bsdus pa 'di// mnga' ris chos mdzad ma yis ni// bskul nas skyu ra grags pa'i ming*// 'dzin des sbyar ba 'gro smin shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
